description: This file defines a class S3Logger for logging events to an S3 bucket, including methods for initializing the logger, logging events asynchronously, and constructing S3 object keys. It also includes a utility function for generating S3 object keys based on parameters.

classes.name: S3Logger
classes.description: A class for logging events to an Amazon S3 bucket, supporting configuration via parameters and environment variables, with methods for logging and constructing S3 object keys.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the S3Logger with configuration parameters, creates an S3 client, and handles environment variable substitution.

methods.name: _async_log_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs an event by calling the log_event method.

methods.name: log_event
methods.description: Constructs a payload and uploads it to S3, handling metadata cleaning and filename generation.
